subject: rt-algn
title: RT.ALGN.-----ALT.F.
description: Diagram in R(AS)CM(II)-38 — the section on the realness of alternative recording in the late-sixties as the beginning 'of a whole new period — and thrust continuum — for earth culture.' The prose immediately above frames the structural object: 'the realness of what this sector has contributed to the total community is very important. Their survival has meant the beginning of a whole new period.' The crossing diagrams what reality-alignment actually crosses with when alternative-functionalism is the working partner: RT-ALGN (reality alignment — the alignment between the form and its actual world conditions) is crossed with ALT-F (alternative functionalism). RT-ALGN sits at the lower left with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs up-right to ALT-F. Three lines leave the main line: a vertical rises to ECO-DYM (economic dynamics), with SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) branching from it at the upper left; a line runs right to C-INFO (composite information), with MT-INTR (multiple interpretation) hanging from it and BIA (bi-aitional) branching from it to the upper right; and a vertical drops to CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism), with POL-P (political policies) branching from it, MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) branching in turn from POL-P, and PHY-U-C (physical universe context) branching from MT-DEVF.
